description: This file defines React components for managing and displaying marketplace plugin items, including update prompts, confirmation modals, and install/configure buttons within a Mattermost plugin marketplace UI.

classes.name: MarketplaceItemPlugin
classes.description: React component class for displaying a plugin item in the marketplace, handling install, configure, and update actions, including modals for update confirmation.

methods.name: showUpdateConfirmationModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the update confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideUpdateConfirmationModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the update confirmation modal.

methods.name: onInstall
methods.description: Triggers plugin installation via props actions.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Triggers closing the marketplace modal for plugin configuration.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles plugin update by hiding modal and triggering install.

methods.name: getItemButton
methods.description: Returns the appropriate button for install or configure based on plugin state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the plugin marketplace item, including buttons, version labels, update details, and modals.
